name: waygraph-quickstart
description: Self-contained saucedemo quickstart (copied into a temp dir by `waygraph try demo`).

scripts.demo: waygraph demo --blocks "loginFlow then shopFlow({\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}) then viewerBlockedFlow({\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"locked_out_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}})" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}}"
scripts.demo:auto-next: waygraph demo --blocks "loginFlow then shopFlow({\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}) then viewerBlockedFlow({\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"locked_out_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}})" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}}" --auto-next
scripts.record: waygraph run --blocks "loginFlow then shopFlow({\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}) then viewerBlockedFlow({\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"locked_out_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}})" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}}" --video --no-step
scripts.run:bulk: waygraph run --blocks "loginFlow then add-all-to-cart then remove-all-from-cart" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}}"
